slides.title: Loan Processing Agent
slides.subtitle: Multi-Agent Orchestration with Google ADK, AutoRAG, and Human-in-the-Loop

slides.title: End-to-end loan processing — fully automated, fully auditable

stats.label: One orchestrator agent coordinates four specialized sub-agents via ADK AgentTool
9-doc regulatory corpus (SBA, ECOA, Reg B) retrieved at underwriting and decision time
Human-in-the-loop pause after pricing — no loan approved without explicit user consent
SQLite-backed state persistence enables repair & resume across pod restarts and sessions

items.label: Separation of Concerns
items.description: Each sub-agent has one job, its own prompt, its own output schema, and only the tools it needs

items.label: Guardrails at Every Layer
items.description: before_agent, before_tool, before_model, and after_agent callbacks enforce policy at every step

items.label: LLM-as-Judge Gate
items.description: Every orchestrator response is validated for trajectory, grounding, and completeness before reaching the user

items.label: Dual-Write State
items.description: ADK session state + SQLite persistence — the agent can survive restarts and resume from any checkpoint

slides.title: The agent roster — 5 agents, each with a specific role
rows: Coordinates the full pipeline, loads skills, manages HITL
Extracts structured data from loan applications (PDF/text)
Validates data, checks SBA eligibility, assesses risk
Calculates interest rate, monthly payment, risk tier
Generates approval or decline letters with regulatory compliance

slides.title: The happy path — from application to approval in one conversation
bullets: **Step 1** — User submits a loan application → check_process_status initializes tracking in SQLite
**Step 2** — DocumentExtractionAgent parses the application into structured LoanApplicationData
**Step 3** — UnderwritingAgent queries AutoRAG for SBA eligibility rules and industry guidance, then validates
**Step 4** — PricingAgent calculates rate, monthly payment, and total interest based on risk tier
**Step 5** — Orchestrator presents pricing and pauses for human approval (HITL)
**Step 6** — User approves → LoanDecisionAgent generates a formal approval letter
**Quality gate** — LLM-as-Judge validates the entire response before it reaches the user

slides.title: AutoRAG — retrieval-augmented regulatory knowledge
leftItems: OGX vector store with Milvus + nomic-embed-text-v1.5 embeddings
UnderwritingAgent: 2 LLM tool-call queries (eligibility + industry guidance)
LoanDecisionAgent: 1 internal auto-call on decline path (ECOA adverse action)
max_num_results=3 per query — focused, low-latency retrieval
Graceful degradation: if AutoRAG is unavailable, falls back to static eligibility_rules.json
rightItems: ECOA / Reg B adverse action notice rules

slides.title: Callbacks — policy enforcement at every lifecycle point
bullets: **before_agent** — extract_request_id: parses loan ID from user messages, stores inline documents for later injection
**before_tool** — halt/skip guard: blocks tool execution if process is halted, completed, or if pricing should be skipped for ineligible loans
**before_model** — inject_document: injects PDF/image documents into the LLM request context for DocumentExtractionAgent
**after_agent** — state logging: persists every sub-agent output to SQLite via ProcessStateService
**after_agent** — LLM-as-Judge: validates trajectory correctness, grounding, and response completeness on every orchestrator turn

slides.title: Repair & resume — surviving failures and restarts
leftItems: ProcessStateService: SQLite-backed service tracking overall_status, current_step, and per-agent step data
Dual-write: ADK session state + SQLite on every sub-agent completion
check_process_status: reloads all completed step data from SQLite into a fresh ADK session
rightItems: Pod restart between pricing and approval → SQLite reloads completed steps
Missing data detected mid-pipeline → HALT, ask user, resume from failed step
User returns hours later in a new session → check_process_status picks up where it left off
Approval arrives in a fresh API session → _load_step_data_from_db() loads all prior outputs from SQLite

items.label: Secrets
items.description: SealedSecret for LLM API key, ConfigMap for env vars, OpenShell sandbox for network isolation

items.label: MaaS Gateway
items.description: Gemini 2.5 Flash via OpenAI-compatible endpoint (LiteLLM); supports Vertex AI and direct Gemini API

items.label: Persistence
items.description: PVC at /app/data/ for SQLite state DB — survives pod restarts

slides.title: Skills — domain knowledge loaded on demand
bullets: **loan-orchestration-protocol** — Step-by-step HITL workflow: extract → underwrite → price → approve/decline
**loan-eligibility-guide** — 5 SBA eligibility rules, risk flags, and status definitions
**loan-pricing-guide** — Risk tier table (Tier 1–4), rate ranges, presentation format, approval prompt template
**loan-adverse-action** — ECOA requirements, decline letter template, tone and legal compliance guidance
Skills are markdown files loaded by the orchestrator via ADK SkillToolset (list_skills → load_skill) — sub-agents never see them
